title: Decouple Engram refusal-expiry tests from adapter policy
outcome: The stateful Engram fake determines whether begin refusal expires a grant by calling the adapter's own engram_begin_refusal_allows_reevaluation helper. Adapter and fake can therefore drift together while S2/non-expiring tests stay green. The fake must encode Engram's external refusal semantics independently.
acceptance: The fake hard-codes or otherwise independently models Engram's five expiring refusal decisions; a mutation to the adapter policy causes focused tests to fail; production behavior is unchanged.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 final batch 58fdd104, applied by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. An independent five-code fake and an external-contract test are present on master; markers are in note 58fdd104. Closed by evidence; no formal acceptance evaluation was run.
